title: Project Pontes: why a trigger solution is still needed alongside wCBDC-like cash tokens
message_html: Project Pontes: why a trigger solution is still needed alongside wCBDC-like cash tokens ...
snippet: When Project Pontes launches in September it will provide two settlement options for DLT transactions, a wholesale CBDC-like cash token that lives on the Eurosystem’s own DLT, and a trigger solution that links the DLT to the TARGET2 (T2) payment system.
